content.transcript: Here's what finally fixed my ozempic constipation. Here's what actually worked. Miralax, $15. Did nothing. Actually made the bloating worse. Fiber gummies, $25. Sat in my gut like a rock. Stool softeners, prune juice, that gentle tea, another $40. Nothing. Even got a prescription laxative, $60 copay. Cramps so bad I missed work. I was frustrated, bloated, and broke. And I still couldn't go. Then I finally understood why none of it was working. All those products are made for normal digestion. But ozempic doesn't give you normal digestion. It slows your entire system down. Adding bulk to a slow gut just makes a bigger backup. That's why Miralax made it worse. That's why fiber made it worse. It all made sense. What I needed was something designed for a slow GLP-1 gut, not a normal one. This uses magnesium to gently pull water into your gut, softens everything without adding bulk, and ginger to help your stomach actually move food through instead of letting it sit and rot. First morning after taking it, I finally went. No cramps. No emergency. Just relief. It's been a month. I go every single morning now, like clockwork. Wish I'd found this before wasting $200 on stuff that can't work for GLP-1s. Save your money. This one actually works for ozempic constipation. 60-day guarantee if it doesn't. Links below.
